author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಹೊಟ್ಟೆ ಹೊರೆಯಲೆ ಇಲ್ಲಿ ನಾಟಕದ ಅಂಕಗಳು
ಸೊಟ್ಟಿರದ ನೇರನಡೆ ನುಡಿಯೆ ಸಂಗತವು
ಗಟ್ಟಿತನವಿಲ್ಲದಿಹ ಭಾವಗಳೆ ಸೊರಗುತಿರೆ
ಮುಟ್ಟಿನಡೆ ಮನಗಳನು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Here, to fill the belly, there are acts in a play;
straight walking and speech, with no crookedness, are what fit;
when feelings without firmness keep wasting away,
walk on touching hearts, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Much of life is play-acting just to make a living. Yet straightforward conduct is what truly fits. When shallow feelings wither, reach people with real warmth.
